weather.summary: Early morning hours (00-06 UTC) show a high probability of rain (up to 93%) as cloud cover thickens, but by late morning the chance drops sharply, giving a window for dry conditions. A gradual warming follows, with temperatures climbing from 18°C to a peak of about 22°C around 16-18 UTC, then easing back to mid-teens by the next day. Overall, the forecast is dominated by cloudy skies with a brief high-risk rain period early on, followed by a mild heat spell and low precipitation chances thereafter.
